Generated: 2026-09-29. No MATLAB run. Original logs are now archived in archive/V8_LEGACY_LOGS_2026-09-29.zip; RESULT_*_V8.txt now use the slot-average scale.
Scope: final Joint PSO, Full PSO and Full IPSO results for runs 1-20.
Definition: slot-average rate = DL-phase rate * T_DL / (T_UL + T_DL).
V8 assumes equal UL/DL durations, hence the physical duty cycle is 1/2.
Under zero constraint penalty and lambdaSmooth=0: F_slot_average = F_native / 2.
All 60 printed final penalties are zero. Fitness agrees with min + lambdaMean*mean
  - lambdaFair*mean*(1-Jain), within the precision of the printed Jain values.
Historical lambdaSmooth is not explicitly logged; its zero value is consistent
  with the current V8 code and the above reconstruction, and is assumed here.
Values retain only the precision present in the logs. Jain is unchanged by scaling.
Min/mean/global rates below are slot-average bit/s; mean is mean of per-slot user minima.
Straight-trajectory baseline excluded: its historical fitness omits fairness and cannot
  be made identical to the new common baseline fitness merely by dividing by 2.
This changes the reporting scale only. It does not equalize optimization budgets,
  add uplink data-flow constraints, or calculate EE, demand feasibility, or cache effects.
